verdict.rationale: The pack documents Get ACH details, account validation and ownership verification. These return account data to the developer. Nothing documents processor integrations, processor tokens, or a token exchange that hands verified credentials to a third-party payment processor or platform. Retrieving ACH details and forwarding them yourself is a developer building block, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, linked accounts plug into my payment processor — documented integrations or token exchange that hand verified account credentials to third-party processors and platforms
